title: Weak Cosmic Censorship in Asymptotically Flat Spacetimes
exact_target: Establish or refute weak cosmic censorship in suitable asymptotically flat settings and identify its geometric and dimensional hypotheses.

sources.citation: ULAM.AI and the UnsolvedMath Contributors, UnsolvedMath, record 30003910 (OWR-16411-002). Catalogue curation under CC BY 4.0; definitions and English exposition added locally.
Mathematical General Relativity (2018), Oberwolfach Reports, DOI 10.4171/owr/2018/36, pp. 2157--2251. Primary report accessed 2026-10-11; relevant PDF pages 35.
Figueras--Kunesch--Tunyasuvunakool--Lehner 2020 (catalogue-listed context; not independently consulted in this preparation).

status_qualification: The question asks to specify the hypotheses, and does not assert censorship for every data set or every matter model. Genericity, asymptotic structure and the precise singularity/completeness formulation are not fixed in the catalogue extraction.
